column1: # Sarah: a human with a pike, met four times (Vault, Kalay, Tolbi, Lalivero), stronger each time.

column3:
A traveler here in Kalay
claims he saw a girl
I'm looking for.{page_break}Short golden hair.
Purple eyes. She's family.{page_break}But when I asked where,
he couldn't tell me.
It's always the same.{end_wait}
Because one of them\nmight be true.{page_break}I need to stay sharp.\nWill you spar with me?{end_wait}

Well fought.
You're quite skilled.{page_break}The rumor may be false.
Still, I can't ignore it.
Not yet.{end_wait}

My name is Sarah.
I'm a knight from the
Western Continent.{page_break}I'm looking for a girl.
Short golden hair.
Purple eyes.{page_break}She's family. I'd rather
not give her name
to strangers.{page_break}I have a long road ahead.
I need to stay sharp.{page_break}You carry a sword.
Show me your guard.{end_wait}

You held your ground.
I won't forget that.{page_break}If you hear of the girl,
remember what I told you.
That's all I ask.{end_wait}

A girl I'm looking for
may have passed through
Tolbi.{page_break}Short golden hair.
Purple eyes. She's family.{page_break}No one can tell me
where she went next.{end_wait}
And if you find her?\nWhat happens then?{end_wait}

I don't know.
I've tried to answer
that for myself.{page_break}What if she doesn't
want to see me?{page_break}A match, if you have time.
It's easier to face
a sword than that.{end_wait}

You're a skilled fighter.
I won't deny it.{page_break}If you meet her,
don't tell her my name.
Not until I can explain.{end_wait}

I'm looking for family.
The people here told me
about a girl named Sheba.{page_break}The description fits.
But now she's missing.
I haven't seen her myself.{end_wait}
Do you think she's\nthe one you're looking\nfor?{end_wait}

I can't be sure.
But I can't ignore it.{page_break}If I have to cross the sea,
I need to be ready.
Will you spar with me?{end_wait}

Well fought, Isaac.
Thank you.{page_break}I'll speak to the people
who raised Sheba.
They may know more.{page_break}I have to find out
for myself.{end_wait}
